mechanism: Both drugs affect dopaminergic and monoaminergic systems; modafinil increases dopamine/norepinephrine while valbenazine inhibits VMAT2 increasing synaptic monoamines, creating potential for additive CNS stimulation and sympathomimetic effects.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS stimulation, insomnia, anxiety, tremor, and cardiovascular changes; dose adjustment of modafinil may be warranted in combination therapy.
